definition_zh: 自动机；机器人；动作机械、毫无主见的人
definition_en: a machine that moves by itself; also, a person who acts mechanically, without thinking or feeling
core_image: 上紧发条就自己动起来的机关人偶
scene: 工位上敲了一整天相同按键，他觉得自己快成了机器。After years on the line he worked like an automaton.
sceneCN: 这里 automaton 指「动作机械、不动脑的人」（第 2 个义项：比喻机械的人）；句意：在流水线干了多年，他干活已像机器人一般。

pos.zh: 自动机；机器人；机械行事的人

collocations.zh: 会下棋的自动机（如土耳其行弈傀儡）
没有主见的政坛机器人

derivatives.zh: 自动的；无意识的（同族词）
使自动化（automatic 回构动词）
自动机理论（计算机科学术语，复数形式保留）

senses.title: A self-moving machine
senses.definition: a mechanical figure or device that appears to move by its own power
senses.definitionCN: 仿佛凭自身动力运动的机械人偶或装置
senses.example: The museum's eighteenth-century automaton writes poems with a quill.
senses.exampleCN: 博物馆那台 18 世纪的机关人偶能用羽毛笔写诗。
senses.why: The Greek automatos means self-moving; the word names any machine that seems to act alone.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 automatos 意为「自行运动」；这个词命名一切看似自主运作的机械。

senses.title: A person acting mechanically
senses.definition: a person who acts without thinking, will, or feeling, as if wound up like a machine
senses.definitionCN: 不假思索、没有意志或情感，如上发条般行事的人
senses.example: Slogging through the same routine, he felt like an automaton.
senses.exampleCN: 日复一日重复同样的例行公事，他觉得自己像台机器。
senses.why: Once machines imitated people, people who stopped thinking could be called machines back.
senses.whyCN: 机器一旦模仿了人，不再思考的人便被反称为机器。

senses.title: Automatic devices in engineering
senses.definition: any self-regulating mechanism, from clockwork to feedback systems
senses.definitionCN: 从钟表机械到反馈系统的各种自调节机构
senses.example: The temple doors of Heron of Alexandria were famous automatons.
senses.exampleCN: 亚历山大城的希伦所造神庙自动门是著名的自动装置。
senses.why: Ancient engineers already built self-acting machines, and the old word still fits them.
senses.whyCN: 古代工程师早已造出自动机械，这个古老的词至今仍然适用。

senses.title: In mathematics and computing
senses.titleCN: 数学与计算机中的自动机
senses.definition: an abstract model of computation, such as a finite automaton
senses.definitionCN: 计算的抽象模型，如有限自动机
senses.example: A finite automaton accepts or rejects strings of symbols.
senses.exampleCN: 有限自动机接受或拒绝符号串。
senses.why: Computer science needed a precise name for abstract machines that act by rule alone.
senses.whyCN: 计算机科学需要一个精确的名字来指称纯粹按规则运行的抽象机器。

senses.title: Robots and androids
senses.definition: a robot, especially one built in human form, in older or literary use
senses.definitionCN: 机器人，尤指人形机械，见于较旧或文学用法
senses.example: The novel imagined automatons serving breakfast in every home.
senses.exampleCN: 这部小说想象家家都有机器人备好早餐。
senses.why: Before robot was coined in 1920, automaton carried the whole fantasy.
senses.whyCN: 1920 年 robot 一词诞生之前，automaton 独自承载着全部想象。

senses.title: Blind obedience
senses.definition: someone who obeys orders without question
senses.definitionCN: 不加质疑、唯命是从的人
senses.example: The dictatorship preferred citizens who behaved like automatons.
senses.exampleCN: 独裁政权更喜欢像机器一样顺从的公民。
senses.why: A person who never chooses has surrendered the self-moving power the word names.
senses.whyCN: 从不选择的人，恰恰交出了这个词所说的「自行运动」的能力。

senses.title: In philosophy of mind
senses.definition: a hypothetical being that behaves outwardly human but has no inner experience
senses.definitionCN: 外在行为与人类无异却无内在体验的假想存在
senses.example: Philosophers ask whether we could ever prove another person is not an automaton.
senses.exampleCN: 哲学家追问：我们能否证明他人不是没有内心的自动机？
senses.why: The machine-with-a-face raises the hardest question: where does the mind hide?
senses.whyCN: 顶着人脸的机器提出最艰难的问题：心灵藏在何处？

senses.title: In biology and ethology
senses.definition: an animal or organ acting by fixed mechanisms rather than intelligence
senses.definitionCN: 凭固定机制而非智能行动的动物或器官
senses.example: Descartes treated animal bodies as automatons.
senses.exampleCN: 笛卡尔把动物的身体视为自动机。
senses.why: Descartes split mind from body, leaving animal bodies as self-running machinery.
senses.whyCN: 笛卡尔将心灵与身体分离，动物的身体遂成了自行运转的机械。

intro.en: Automaton comes from Greek automatos, self-moving or acting of one's own will, from autos, self, plus a verb root meaning to think or intend; English borrowed it via Latin in the early seventeenth century.
intro.cn: automaton 出自希腊语 automatos「自行运动、出于己意的」，由 autos「自身」加表「思虑、意图」的动词词根构成；17 世纪初经拉丁语进入英语。

items.en: The root *men- meant to think or intend, the same root seen in mind and memory.
items.cn: 词根 *men- 意为「思考、意图」，与 mind、memory 同根。

items.en: autos meant self and a root -matos pointed to intent; automatos meant moving of oneself, unbidden.
items.cn: 希腊语 autos 意为「自身」，-matos 指向意图；automatos 意为自行运动、不召自来。

items.en: Homer used automata of Hephaestus' self-moving golden handmaidens; engineers like Heron built real ones.
items.cn: 荷马用 automata 描写赫菲斯托斯自行运动的黄金侍女；希伦等工程师造出了真实的自动机械。

items.en: Latin adopted automatum for self-moving devices in learned texts.
items.cn: 拉丁语以 automatum 指称学术文本中的自动装置。

items.en: English took automaton in the 1610s, first for self-moving machines and clockwork figures.
items.cn: 17 世纪 10 年代英语收入 automaton，最初指自动机械与发条人偶。

items.en: The 18th-century automaton craze, then computing, gave us both the mocking human sense and the finite automaton.
items.cn: 18 世纪的机关人偶热潮与后来的计算科学，既给了我们讥人的用法，也给了我们有限自动机。

note.en: Group one collects the auto- family and look-alikes; group two collects neighboring machine and obedience words.
note.cn: 第一组收 auto- 词族及形近词；第二组收相邻的机械与盲从词。

entries.definition: self-acting; the adjective of the same Greek automatos.
entries.definitionCN: 自动的；同一希腊词 automatos 的形容词。

entries.definition: the use of self-acting machinery in industry.
entries.definitionCN: 自动化；工业中自动机械的运用。

entries.definition: a self-moving vehicle, from mobile, movable; shares auto- only.
entries.definitionCN: 汽车，出自 mobile「可动的」；仅共享 auto-。

entries.definition: an absolute ruler, from kratos, power; shares auto- but rules people, not gears.
entries.definitionCN: 独裁者，出自 kratos「权力」；共享 auto- 而统辖的是人不是齿轮。

entries.definition: self-shaped, from morphe, form; a mathematics word sharing only the prefix.
entries.definitionCN: 自同构的，出自 morphe「形」；数学词，仅共享前缀。

entries.definition: a mechanical agent, from Czech robota, forced labor; coined in 1920.
entries.definitionCN: 机器人，出自捷克语 robota「苦役」，1920 年创造。

entries.definition: a robot in human form, from Greek andros, man.
entries.definitionCN: 人形机器人，出自希腊语 andros「人」。

entries.definition: any mechanical device; the plain general term.
a figure moved by strings or hands, often of a controlled person.
entries.definitionCN: 木偶；常喻受人摆布之人。

entries.definition: a dull, unfeeling worker; also an unmanned craft.
entries.definitionCN: 乏味麻木的劳工；亦指无人机。

normalIntro.en: automaton hides three Greek parts: auto for self, mat for intent, on for being.
normalIntro.cn: automaton 藏着三个希腊成分：auto「自身」、mat「意图」、on「存在」。

normal.en: auto (self) + matos (moving of intent): a thing that moves by itself.
normal.cn: auto（自身）+ matos（出于意图的运动）：自己会动的东西。

normal.en: The family: automatic, automation, automate, automaton.
Plural check: automatons or the Greek automata.
normal.cn: 复数两选一：automatons 或希腊式的 automata。

normal.en: Before robot (1920), automaton was the only word for a mechanical person.
normal.cn: 在 robot（1920）出现前，automaton 是机械人的唯一称呼。

normal.en: Figurative use: an automaton works without thinking, wound up like clockwork.
normal.cn: 比喻用法：automaton 干活不假思索，如上了发条。

abstract.en: Picture a lacquered doll writing a poem as its gears tick.
abstract.cn: 想象一座漆偶在齿轮滴答声中写诗。

abstract.en: The word is a person with the mind taken out, just the motion left.
abstract.cn: 这个词是被抽走心灵、只剩动作的人。

abstract.en: An automaton never asks why; that is the horror and the point.
abstract.cn: automaton 从不问为什么——这正是它的可怖之处，也是此词的要害。

examples.en: The clockmaker's automaton bows to the audience every hour.
examples.cn: 钟表匠造的机关人偶每逢整点向观众鞠躬。

examples.en: He answered the interview questions like an automaton.
examples.cn: 他回答面试问题时像机器人一样刻板。

examples.en: Every finite automaton has states, inputs, and rules.
examples.cn: 每个有限自动机都有状态、输入与规则。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「奥透美瞳」——戴上美瞳的奥透像人偶一样，表情僵硬、动作机械

root: 出自希腊语 automatos「自行运动的」（autos「自身」+ 词根 *men-「思虑」的 -matos 形式），荷马已用以描写神匠的自动侍女；经拉丁语 automatum 于 17 世纪初进入英语；与 automatic、automation 同根，与 autocrat（kratos「权力」）仅共享 auto-，词源确凿。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses trace one word from Homer's golden handmaidens to finite-state machines: self-moving devices, mechanical people, blind obedience, and the philosophical puppet that looks human.
sensesIntro.cn: 八义词追溯一个词从荷马的黄金侍女到有限状态机的全程：自行的机械、机械化的人、盲从者，以及形似人类的哲学傀儡。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: motion without a mind, a figure that moves as if it chose to.
core.cn: 核心意象：没有心灵的运动，仿佛出于自身选择而动的人偶。

branches.en: THE MACHINE SIDE: clockwork figures, temple doors, and feedback devices.
branches.cn: 机械一面：发条人偶、神庙自动门与反馈装置。

branches.en: THE HUMAN SIDE: workers and citizens who stop choosing.
branches.cn: 人身一面：不再做选择的工人与公民。

branches.en: THE THEORY SIDE: finite automata in mathematics and computing.
branches.cn: 理论一面：数学与计算机中的有限自动机。

branches.en: THE ROBOT SIDE: the older name for what we now call robots.
branches.cn: 机器人一面：如今所谓 robot 的旧称。

branches.en: THE PHILOSOPHY SIDE: minds questioned in faces and animal bodies.
branches.cn: 哲学一面：被追问心灵的人脸与兽身。

intro.en: automaton is autos plus a verb stem for intent plus the Greek noun ending; the auto- prefix carries the self-moving idea.
intro.cn: automaton 由 autos 加表意图的动词词干再加希腊名词词尾构成；auto- 前缀承载「自行运动」之意。

latinIntro.en: Greek automatos seeded a large family through Latin: automatic, automation, automate, and automaton itself.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语 automatos 经拉丁语播下庞大家族：automatic、automation、automate，以及 automaton 本身。
